why: Hand-set 2026-09-28 (design section 10, decision 4), reviewed like code. Unit: request-seconds of delay. Cost weights only move cost(); memory_margin is a safety parameter read by feasible() and is NOT a cost weight. Change a value by adding v2.json, never by editing this file: decisions record this file's sha256. change_cost = restart_downtime_s x expected request rate x unserved (each request arriving during the restart goes unserved, 30 request-seconds) + risk_prior_per_new_flag per never-started launch flag.
